context: The deterministic tally is documented as authoritative for the merge gate; panel_shortfall is documented to mean peers actually failed, not resource caps.

claims.text: DEFECT: the context-budget guard reassigns panel_results to the trimmed list before the tally runs, so a resource-cap trim is counted as missing votes and reported as a transport panel_shortfall
DEFECT: the reassignment makes every downstream use of panel_results, including the run result and the tally input, see the trimmed list instead of the full evidence
